user_input: Plan a 10-day trip to Portugal in October, budget $2,000.
expected_behavior: Ask for city, year/exact dates, flight origin, occupancy and currency/budget scope before a priced plan.
success_criteria: Clarification covers every missing required field; offers Lisbon as supported coverage without selecting it; no quotes or budget-fit claim.
failure_edge_cases: Inventing an airport or dates; assuming Portugal means Lisbon; treating ambiguous dollars as confirmed USD.
